label: diagnostic upper bound, not a system result

env.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

config.phase: feasibility, dev only (EXP110 P01-P04). Not the registered E3a experiment.
config.image_space: raw distorted pixels 1920x1080. Relation distances here are PIXEL gaps (provisional, not metres).

queries.en: the small pallet closest to the truck
the small pallet next to the charging station
the small pallet with blocks on it
the small pallet with the blue block on it
the small pallet next to the forklift

config.parser_prompt: You convert a robot command about one object into JSON. Known object classes in this site: {vocab}. Return JSON only: {{"target": "<class>", "relation": "closest_to" | "next_to" | "empty" | "loaded" | "has_color" | "none", "reference": "<class or null>", "color": "red" | "blue" | null}}. Command: "{q}"
config.jvlm_prompt: Numbered boxes mark the small pallets in this image. Which numbered box is "{q}"? Judge it from the image. Return JSON only: {{"id": <number>}} if exactly one box matches, {{"id": null, "reason": "none"}} if no box matches, or {{"id": null, "reason": "ambiguous"}} if more than one box matches equally.

relation_rule_px.gap: shortest pixel distance between the two boxes (0 if they overlap); several reference instances -> the minimum
relation_rule_px.next_to_note: next_to accepted if gap <= factor x max side of the reference box (pixel-relative, provisional)
relation_rule_px.ambiguity_note: if the 2nd smallest gap - smallest gap < margin x max side of the reference box -> ambiguous

config.groups_note: spatial = 순수 공간 관계(기준 물체와의 위치), state = 시각적 상태(적재 여부, 블록 색). 두 묶음을 따로 보고한다 (사용자 지시 2026-11-15).
config.map_note: J-geo의 기준 물체(트럭, 충전기 등)는 두 출처 모두 고정물 정답 박스를 쓴다 = M-map 사전 지도 대용 (고정물은 움직이지 않음, 계획서 v3 §8.3). 소형 팔레트와 블록은 지도에 넣지 않는다.

result_categories.false_select: 정답이 없는데 어떤 대상을 고름(잘못된 대상 선택의 한 종류)
result_categories.invalid: 출력 형식 오류 (JSON 아님, 스키마 위반, 후보에 없는 번호)

schema_rules.parser: object; relation in the 6 values; has_color needs color red|blue; closest_to/next_to need a string reference. reference may be a site name or its class (both accepted, case-insensitive).
schema_rules.jvlm: object with key id; id is an int that is one of the candidate ids, or null; reason (if present) is none|ambiguous.

referents_status: DRAFT by Claude 2026-11-15 from the answer-key positions and human-style judgement, NOT from the Python relation rule. Needs user review (referents_check_P0*.jpg). Boxes = EXP110 answer-key small_pallet boxes, raw distorted px.
